entries.title: How To Arrange Hundreds of Atoms Between Two Mirrors
entries.summary: Author(s): Sophia Chen A new device in which more than 600 atoms are manipulated within a single optical cavity could allow for the scaling up of neutral-atom quantum computers. [Physics 19, s126] Published Thu Oct 08, 2026

entries.title: Enzymes Strongly Affect Sequestered Biomolecules
entries.summary: Author(s): David Ehrenstein Regions within a cell in which biomolecules are concentrated, called condensates, form different structures when enzymes are involved, according to experiments. [Physics 19, s139] Published Thu Oct 08, 2026

entries.title: How researchers tell different quantum excitations apart in individual molecules
entries.summary: Molecules can be placed in a wide variety of quantum states. How can these states be distinguished in measurements when theoretical models are unreliable? Which excitation process lies behind which measurement signal?
